metal_fabrication_process.label: Metal-fabrication process
metal_fabrication_process.value: Stainless steel sink fabrication and powder-coated metal washroom partition and locker manufacturing, plus plumbing product and water cooler assembly

custom_standardized_component_mix.label: Custom / standardized component mix
custom_standardized_component_mix.value: Mostly standardized catalog plumbing and water products, with engineered water solutions for construction projects

end_market_qualifications.label: End-market qualifications

notes: Evidence does not describe fabrication equipment or tolerances; the company is a building-products maker more than a job-shop fabricator.
